title: SingelPortalen
summary: A bilingual dating and chat platform with Admin, Agent and Customer roles, credit purchases, dashboards and real-time WebSocket messaging.
challenge: The platform needed real-time communication and a smooth experience for Swedish and English-speaking users. Polling created unnecessary overhead and limited responsiveness as usage grew.
solution: Designed the three-role product flow for Admin, Agent and Customer users.
Migrated chat architecture from polling to WebSocket messaging with Socket.io.
Implemented customer credit purchases through CCBill integration.
Built agent dashboards for customer relationships, reminders and earnings.
Added multilingual English/Swedish support, favourites and CDN-optimised assets.
Built admin visibility into user activity, chat logs and platform analytics.
outcomes: 40% reduction in page-load time after the architecture change.
